details: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated on September 3, 2026, that he would be inclined to support holding the federal funds rate at its current setting if incoming August inflation data confirms a trend of disinflation. This dovish sentiment from a Fed official was interpreted positively by markets, leading to a surge in cryptocurrency prices, with Bitcoin reclaims $81,000.
title: Fed Governor Waller Hints at Rate Pause, Bolstering Crypto Optimism

details: Stronger-than-expected US job gains in August, with 162,000 new jobs added and the unemployment rate at 4.1%, have raised concerns among investors that the Federal Reserve might maintain a hawkish stance or even consider further interest rate hikes to combat inflation. This uncertainty led to a rapid decline in the cryptocurrency market, with over $200 million in crypto long positions being liquidated within 15 minutes on September 4, 2026, as risk-sensitive assets like cryptocurrencies were repriced lower.
title: Robust US Job Gains Spark Rate Hike Concerns, Leading to Crypto Market Dip

details: On September 3, 2026, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a net inflow of $101 million, indicating continued institutional interest in Bitcoin. In contrast, Ethereum ETFs experienced a net outflow of $48.2 million during the same period, suggesting a divergence in investor sentiment and capital allocation between the two largest cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Inflows While Ethereum Funds Experience Outflows
